data.name: Viju
data.gender_notes: Viju is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Viju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijaya', which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. It is also associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing joy and light. The name Viju carries the meaning “Joy, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Viju usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
